priya: CI smoke failing on hosted-integ (shard 21). Seeing auth + streaming + tool-call errors that started ~2 runs ago. Anyone on-call to eyeball?
ci-bot: <https://ci.redwood.internal/pipeline/4821|Pipeline 4821> failed · tests: hosted-integ/shard-21 · flaky=false · see logs.
alex: Which exact tests are crashing? can you paste a small log snippet?
priya: Failing tests: TestToolCallIntegration::test_tool_auth_flow, TestStreamSession::test_resume. Pattern: tool handshake 401 then stream aborts a few ms later. Not consistent across requests.
priya: Logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-16T18:12:03Z ERROR toolcall: handshake failed status=401 kid=rotate-abc request_id=5f8a
2026-03-16T18:12:03Z WARN stream: client disconnected, reason=auth request_id=5f8a
2026-03-16T18:12:04Z ERROR auth-proxy: token validation failed: kid not found
```
ben: Can we just rerun shard 21 first? I can watch the job and capture more traces.
priya: Yep. Running local rerun command: `./ci/scripts/rerun_shard.sh --suite=hosted-integ --shard=21` — kicking off now with extra debug env.
maria: Also try enabling TOOLCALL_DEBUG and CI_EXTRA_LOG=auth,stream for the rerun so we get full stacks. If the rerun reproduces, we'll have a clearer blame (auth proxy vs token rotation).
priya: Rerun queued. command used: `./ci/scripts/rerun_shard.sh --suite=hosted-integ --shard=21 --env TOOLCALL_DEBUG=true,CI_EXTRA_LOG=auth,stream`
ci-bot: Rerun started: build 4822 · node=gpu-12 · watchers=[ben] · link: <https://ci.redwood.internal/build/4822|build/4822>.
alex: FYI I merged a token-rotation change last night (PR #3487, commit 7a3c2e9). @maria @priya could that overlap with the kid discovery path?
maria: Possible — that PR updated KID caching and fallback order. If rerun reproduces, try flipping KID_CACHE_TTL back to previous value and re-run just the auth-proxy pod in staging.
ben: If the rerun flakes again I'll try a local repro with the uploaded recording. Where is the replay?
priya: Upload placed at s3://redwood-ci/replays/4821/shard21/replay.tar.gz (sanitized). Ben, you can pull and run `./dev/replay --input replay.tar.gz --test TestToolCallIntegration::test_tool_auth_flow`
alex: If this is indeed the rotation PR, I can open a revert PR for the infra change so we can stabilize CI quickly.
priya: Great — will update once rerun completes. thanks all for the quick help. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build/4822 finished · status=failed · tests_failed=2 · flaky=true · artifacts: <https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/4822|artifacts>
priya: Rerun failed but with richer logs — I'm grabbing the full auth-proxy traces now and will paste the salient bits in a follow-up.
